guidelines.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure — Essential Messages
guidelines.recommendation_text: Measurement of NPs and echocardiography have key roles in the diagnosis of HF.
guidelines.locator: ESC Essential Messages, page 2, Diagnostic Workup

guidelines.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure — Essential Messages
guidelines.recommendation_text: The diagnosis of HFpEF requires objective evidence of cardiac structural, or functional abnormalities as well as elevated plasma NP concentrations consistent with the presence of LV diastolic dysfunction and raised LV filling pressures.
guidelines.locator: ESC Essential Messages, page 2, HFpEF Diagnosis
